title: SEG Test Outcome Node
description: Schema for a TestOutcome node in the Safety Evidence Graph. Generated entirely by the CI pipeline from twister test runner output. Sourced from repo C. Immutable once created — a new test run produces new nodes; old nodes are retained permanently as historical record.

id.description: Globally unique IRI for this test outcome. Form: {namespaceBase}/outcome/{runId}/{testcaseId}. Derived automatically by the CI pipeline. Maps to spdxId on SPDX export.

type.description: Fixed SEG type. Maps to spdx:Action on SPDX export.

name.description: Human-readable identifier combining run ID and test case ID. Form: {runId}/{testcaseId}. Must be consistent with the id field.

seg:runId.description: Identifier for the test run that produced this outcome. Groups all test outcomes from a single CI run. Form: RUN-{number} or equivalent CI run identifier.

seg:specId.description: IRI reference to the TestSpecification node this outcome confirms. Must resolve to an existing TestSpecification node. Cross-node validation is enforced at graph level, not schema level.

seg:repoBSha.description: Full 40-character git SHA of repo B at the time this test was executed. Conservative binding — covers the full repo, not individual functions. Any change to repo B requires a new test run. This is the verification anchor for witnesses edges: at proof generation time, the implementation extractor is rerun at this SHA and resulting node hashes are confirmed to match those stored in repo G.

seg:outcome.description: Test execution result. FAIL, ERROR, and SKIPPED outcomes block proof generation unless excused by a valid non-expired Waiver node.

seg:sourceRepo.description: Source repository for this node. Fixed to repoC for all TestOutcome nodes. Resolves to the concrete repo URL defined in config.json.

seg:sourcePath.description: Relative path within repo C to the twister log file from which this test outcome was extracted.

comment.description: Optional free-text note. Not part of the node content and not included in nodeHash computation.
